grades.label: 430-like ferritic, nitrogen-sensitive (demo recipe)
extra_tests: C+N sum for downstream annealing practice

DEMO-A-304L.title: Example A - 304L-like, carbon removal with chromium conservation
DEMO-A-304L.rationale: Standard three-step dilution with N2 in stage 1 (permitted for 304L) and Ar afterwards to strip N; FeSi reduction sized from slag oxide inventory.

DEMO-B-316L.title: Example B - 316L-like, Mo/Ni-bearing, low-carbon endpoint

charge.upstream_route: EAF (30 % DRI in EAF charge, metadata only)

DEMO-B-316L.rationale: Combined-blown AOD-L with top lance in stage 1; Mo and Ni are not oxidised and are recovered as alloy, trimmed by auto-trim.

DEMO-C-430.title: Example C - 430-like ferritic, nitrogen-sensitive (Ar only)
DEMO-C-430.rationale: N2 is forbidden for this grade: all stages run on Ar, which raises gas cost but keeps [N] low; nitrogen balance and reductant trade-offs are shown.

high_cr_loss.title: High chromium loss - over-oxidising late blow
high_cr_loss.explanation: Keeping a high O2:inert ratio at low carbon raises pCO, so C_eq rises and oxygen goes to Cr: slag Cr2O3 and FeSi demand increase.

low_transfer_T.title: Low transfer temperature (1480 C)
low_transfer_T.explanation: Lower T lowers the C-Cr critical temperature margin: more Cr oxidises early and less coolant is needed.

sensor_dropout.title: Off-gas analyzer dropout 12-30 min
sensor_dropout.explanation: Without off-gas data the estimator relies on the physics prior; carbon uncertainty grows and MPC recommendations are withheld when it exceeds the gate.

high_C_input.title: High-carbon transfer (2.2 % C)
high_C_input.explanation: More carbon means more O2, more heat and more coolant.

high_Cr_input.title: High-Cr transfer (19.6 % Cr)
high_Cr_input.explanation: Higher a_Cr shifts the Cr-C equilibrium: higher C_eq at given pCO.

gas_limited.title: Argon supply limitation (Ar capped 60 %)
gas_limited.explanation: Less dilution gives higher pCO and stirring loss: slower low-C decarburisation and higher Cr oxidation.

high_slag_Cr2O3.title: High Cr2O3 carry-over slag
high_slag_Cr2O3.explanation: Extra Cr2O3 in carry-over slag must be recovered with additional FeSi.

n2_sensitive.title: Nitrogen-sensitive grade (Ar only)
n2_sensitive.explanation: Shows N balance with argon-only practice.
